summary: src/stats/style-stats.ts is a pure, synchronous function over in-memory hand data. It has no I/O, network, randomness, dependencies or secrets, and no injection surface: formatStat outputs either a constant or a rounded number followed by '%'. Hidden information: the module reads only seats[].seat, actions (seat/street/type, all public), board.length, result.endedBy and award winners/amounts (public at hand end). It never reads hole cards, and StatHand has no field for them, so opponent stats cannot leak non-showdown holdings. Malformed records: there is no untrusted input path today, because the data comes from the engine or the session. When TASK-3.9 loads stored records, a structurally broken record (missing actions/result/awards) throws a TypeError. That fails closed and does not corrupt state. Records with bad field values (unknown action types or streets) are just not counted. The spec puts record validation in that loader (spec section 8), which is the right boundary. Cost is linear in action count, so there is no resource-exhaustion concern. Test-only changes to tests/bots/style-bands.acceptance.test.ts touch no security surface.
